title: Certified Approximation for Interpretable Representer Landmarks
abstract: arXiv:2609.38901v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Representer explanations rank the training landmarks that most influence a self-supervised representation. At scale, this ranking rests on up to four stacked approximations of the empirical neural tangent kernel (eNTK). These are random output heads, a parameter sketch, landmark sampling and a coefficient fit. Existing analyses bound each approximation separately, but none certifies the top-$K$ set against their combined error. We introduce CAIRN (Certified Approximation for Interpretable Representer laNdmarks), a framework that carries this error through to the ranking. We derive the exact variance of the sketched multi-head eNTK, which matches measurement within $4\%$ where Johnson-Lindenstrauss bounds err by up to $2.5\times$. This yields a high-probability top-$K$ certificate for a fixed coefficient fit, alongside exact residual-trace certificates for discarded spectral mass. An exact product-variance identity separates kernel error

translated_title: 面向可解释表示子地标的认证近似
translated_abstract: 表示子解释器（Representer explanations）通过对自监督表示影响最大的训练地标进行排序来提供解释。在大规模场景下，这一排序依赖于对经验神经正切核（eNTK）的至多四层堆叠近似：随机输出头、参数草图、地标采样以及系数拟合。现有分析仅对每种近似单独给出误差界，但没有任何方法能针对这些近似的组合误差对top-K集合进行认证。我们提出了CAIRN（Certified Approximation for Interpretable Representer laNdmarks，面向可解释表示子地标的认证近似），一个能将误差一路传递到排序结果中的框架。我们推导了草图化多头eNTK的精确方差，其与实际测量值的偏差在4%以内，而Johnson-Lindenstrauss界的误差高达2.5倍。由此，我们得到了固定系数拟合下的高概率top-K认证证书，以及对被丢弃谱质量的精确残差迹证书。一个精确的乘积-方差恒等式将核误差……（摘要至此中断）
tldr: 该论文提出CAIRN框架，首次将对经验神经正切核的四层堆叠近似（随机输出头、参数草图、地标采样、系数拟合）的组合误差传递到表示子解释的top-K排序中，实现了高概率top-K认证证书及对丢弃谱质量的精确残差迹认证。
en_tdlr: CAIRN is a framework that certifies the top-K representer landmark ranking against the combined error of up to four stacked eNTK approximations, yielding high-probability top-K certificates alongside exact residual-trace certificates for discarded spectral mass.
